import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Determine the latest year in the dataset
latest_year = df['StichtagDatJahr'].max()

# Filter the dataset for the latest year to get the most current distribution
df_latest_year = df[df['StichtagDatJahr'] == latest_year]

# Count the occurrences of each primary dog breed (Rasse1Text)
# Assuming each row represents one dog registration.
breed_counts = df_latest_year['Rasse1Text'].value_counts()

# Select the top 15 breeds for visualization
top_n = 15
top_breeds = breed_counts.nlargest(top_n)

# Set up the plot style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create the figure and axes
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a horizontal bar plot
sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.values, y=top_breeds.index, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title(f'Top {top_n} Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich ({latest_year})', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)

# Improve layout
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.xticks(rotation=0) # Ensure x-axis labels are horizontal
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
